title: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
full_text: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201314 Act Number: 14 Enactment Date: 2013-04-22 Act Year: 2013 Short Title: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 Long Title: An Act to provide protection against sexual harassment of women at workplace and for the prevention and redressal of complaints of sexual harassment and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of DEPARTMENT OF WOMAN AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT Enforcement Date: 09-12-2013 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Women and Child Development, ) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 9th December, 2013, vide notification No. S.O. 3606(E), dated 9th December, 2013, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).
